headless.method: Serialized unthrottled deterministic host, three repetitions per 3000-frame condition; 108000-frame (30.1 emulated minutes) 2x stress per mode. CPU is process kernel+user time divided by wall time; speed metrics are headroom, not live frontend timing. Disk/native capture overhead is included; no physical-device underrun inference.

frontend.method: Serialized D3D11/XAudio2 muted 900-frame real RetroArch runs, 2x toggle sent at 2 seconds. Rates are boot-inclusive averages; per-mode CPU includes frontend/GPU-driver/audio work. Ring counters are core diagnostics, not physical audio-device underruns.
